QuestInfo.name: To the Temple of Time!
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# has an urgent message for you.
QuestInfo.1: You received an important mission from #p1101002# to go to the Temple of Time and help #bInformant #p1103006##k.

0.0: I have need of you again. Go to the Temple of Time and meet #bInformant #p1103006##k. She is collecting intelligence on the Black Mage and could use an assistant.

yes.0: #p1103006# is in need of some help. You'll hurry, I presume?

no.0: Go ahead and finish your business here. The mission can wait.

1.0: Oh jeez! I've been waiting on some help from Neinheart! He sent you, right? I was starting to worry about you because you took so long. This place is dangerous!

yes.0: The m-monsters here are way strong. it's a good thing I don't stand out very much. None of them really even seem to notice me...

npc.0: #p1103006# will await your arrival at the #m270000100#. Please find out if she has anything new to tell us.
